title: Fix 'cannot mount squashfs' error in Snap
summary: Resolve the error 'system does not fully support snapd: cannot mount squashfs image using "squashfs"' by ensuring the SquashFS kernel module is loaded.

aliases.text: system does not fully support snapd

error_patterns: system does not fully support snapd: cannot mount squashfs image using "squashfs"

steps.explain: Check if the squashfs kernel module is loaded by listing loaded modules.
If the module is not loaded or if you recently installed snapd, reboot the system.

warnings: If you have recently installed the snapd package, you may need to reboot Arch Linux before installing Snap packages.
